title: Are these holiday lets suitable for families?

post.title: Are these holiday lets suitable for families?
post.html: Yes, we welcome families at our holiday cottages. We have a children’s play area which is a favourite among many of our younger guests. We also provide travel cots, highchairs and stair gates for use within our properties.

description: Yes. Families are welcome, with a children's play area, and travel cots, highchairs and stair gates available in our cottages.
